title: 1. Definitions
body: In these terms, "Vodafone" means Vodafone Qatar Q.P.S.C., "the Customer" means the person named in the application form, and "the Service" means the mobile postpaid service and any add-ons selected in the order.

title: 2. The Service
body: Vodafone provides the Service to the Customer from the activation date shown in the order. Coverage, speeds and availability may vary by location and are not guaranteed. Vodafone may change, suspend or withdraw features of the Service by giving the Customer reasonable notice.

title: 3. Minimum commitment and early termination
body: The selected plan carries a minimum commitment period, shown in the order summary. If the Customer ends the Service before the commitment period finishes, charges for the remainder of the commitment may apply, together with any outstanding amounts and any benefit that was conditional on the commitment.

title: 4. Charges and billing
body: The Customer agrees to pay the monthly recurring charge, usage outside the plan allowance, one-time charges and applicable taxes. Bills are issued on the bill cycle shown in the order. The first bill may include a partial charge for the period from activation to the first bill date, and one month in advance.

title: 5. Payment, credit limit and bill limit
body: The Customer must pay each bill by its due date. Vodafone sets a credit limit and may apply a bill limit; use above the limit may be restricted until payment is received. Late payment may lead to suspension and collection action.

title: 6. Number selection
body: A number chosen from the Star or reserved ranges may carry a one-time charge above the entitlement of the plan and may carry its own minimum period. Numbers remain the property of the regulator and are not transferable except as the regulator's rules allow.

title: 7. SIM and eSIM
body: The SIM or eSIM remains the property of Vodafone. The Customer must keep it secure and report loss or theft immediately. An eSIM activation code can be installed on one device and must not be shared.

title: 8. Customer information and privacy
body: Vodafone collects and uses the Customer's information to provide the Service, verify identity, bill, and meet legal obligations, and shares it only as the law allows. The Customer confirms the information supplied is accurate and agrees to keep it up to date.

title: 9. Acceptable use
body: The Service must be used lawfully and must not be used to harass others, send unsolicited bulk messages or interfere with the network. Vodafone may suspend the Service where use breaches these terms or the law.

title: 10. Changes, complaints and governing law
body: Vodafone may update these terms with notice to the Customer. Complaints can be raised through any Vodafone channel and, if unresolved, with the regulator. These terms are governed by the laws of the State of Qatar.
